intro.header: Converting Between Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
intro.note: Answer each question in your workbook. Show your working.
methodSteps: 5  Decimal → Fraction: use place value, simplify
commonMistakes: Dividing the wrong way round — numerator ÷ denominator, not the other way.
Forgetting to × 100 when going from decimal to percentage.
workedExample: Convert 3/8 to a decimal and then to a percentage.
intro.visualAid: Equivalence triangle showing: FRACTION at top, DECIMAL at bottom-left, PERCENTAGE at bottom-right. Arrows labelled: '÷ bottom' (Frac→Dec), '× 100' (Dec→%), '÷ 100' (%→Dec), 'over 100, simplify' (%→Frac), 'place value, simplify' (Dec→Frac).

questions.content: Convert to decimals: a) 1/2  b) 1/4  c) 3/4  d) 1/10
Convert to percentages: a) 0.5  b) 0.25  c) 0.1  d) 0.75
Convert to simplest fractions: a) 50%  b) 25%  c) 20%  d) 75%
Convert by dividing: a) 3/5  b) 7/8  c) 2/3 (3 d.p.)
Order smallest to largest: 0.35,  1/3,  30%,  7/20. Show working.
40 pupils: 15 football, 10 basketball, rest swimming. a) Fraction for football (simplify). b) % basketball. c) Decimal for swimming.
Tom says '0.45 > 4/9 because 45 > 4.' a) Convert 4/9 to a decimal. b) Is Tom correct? Explain. c) Find a fraction between them.
